name: Loud Bass: High Amplitude + Low Frequency
description: Combine maximum amplitude with low frequency. Observe that you get deep, widely-spaced, high-contrast wave arcs - a visualization of what the ear perceives as a loud, deep sound.

successCriteria.description: Observe widely-spaced arcs (long wavelength) at low frequency
Observe high-contrast wave pattern at maximum amplitude

hints.message: This is what a loud bass drum would look like as a wave: wide arcs with strong contrast.
